name: guard_unknown_essay_unchanged

name: apply_required_essay_uses_draft

name: apply_cover_non_empty_sets_ok

name: apply_cover_null_is_missing
spec_quote: If cover is null/empty, the field is added to missing.

name: apply_essay_already_ok_left_alone
spec_quote: Essay-like fields that already have an ok answer are left alone and are not missing.

name: apply_non_essay_unknown_never_missing
